outcome: Number of membrane sweepings to initiate labor
cohort: Women with a previous cesarean section
finding: Membrane sweeping did not demonstrate a beneficial effect on obstetrical outcomes in women with a previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: The rate of VBAC was 17.3% in the membrane sweeping group compared to 18.7% in the control group, and the rate of cesarean section was 82.7% in the membrane sweeping group compared to 81.3% in the control group.
